test_title: SSC CHSL 2025 Tier-1 (Held On: 29 Nov, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Rs. 6000 is invested in a scheme of compound interest (compounding annually) at the annual rate of 20 percent. What will be the difference between compound interest of second year and third year?
solution:
**Given:**

P = 6000

R = 20%

**Formula Used:**

Amount = P × (1 + R ÷ 100)ⁿ

CI of a year = Amount of that year − Amount of previous year

**Calculation:**

⇒ A₁ = 6000 × 1.2 = 7200

⇒ A₂ = 6000 × (1.2)² = 6000 × 1.44 = 8640

⇒ A₃ = 6000 × (1.2)³ = 6000 × 1.728 = 10368

⇒ CI in 2nd year = 8640 − 7200 = 1440

⇒ CI in 3rd year = 10368 − 8640 = 1728

⇒ Difference = 1728 − 1440 = 288

**∴ The correct answer is 288.**
